'''M-04-37''' was a medical file regarding the injuries and [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of several workers in [[Morjanssik]] following a release of toxic gas caused by a malfunctioning environmental control unit. Five workers [[Death/Legends|died]] as a result of the gas, and ten more were incapacitated .
